title: Captain Vane's own quest text promises the smugglers' road 'for 15 gold, or a favor worth the same to me,' but no dialogue option with her ever lets you ask what the favor is. It only surfaces indirectly after finishing an unrelated quest (dealing with Rook at the Rope Larder).
where: Captain Vane's Tent / talk to Captain Sorrel Vane
